retail_vs_institutional_reaction.retail_sentiment_summary: Retail investors on r/dividends and X viewed the -4.64% after-hours pullback to $239.80 (after a +4.21% run-up during regular trading from $241.30 to $251.46) as a classic 'sell-the-news' reaction to the slight headline GAAP revenue print ($17,103M vs $17,550M Street consensus, though +6% in constant currency). Dividend and value investors praised the $2.95 Operating Non-GAAP EPS beat (vs $2.87 consensus) and the raised full-year FCF outlook (>$1B YoY increase).
retail_vs_institutional_reaction.institutional_sentiment_summary: Institutional desks focused on the high quality of IBM's mix shift: Software revenue beat at $7,804M (+8.2% YoY, +8.7% CC) with a 35.0% segment profit margin, Data software surged +20% CC, Distributed Infrastructure jumped +31% YoY, Operating Non-GAAP Pre-Tax margin expanded +70 bps YoY to 19.3%, and Q3 GAAP OCF jumped +30.6% YoY to $4,025M.
retail_vs_institutional_reaction.after_hours_movement_driver: After rallying from $241.30 to $251.46 into the close, IBM retraced -4.64% after hours to $239.80 as quant algorithms reacted to reported USD revenue of $17,103M vs $17,550M consensus, even as fundamental PMs bought the dip on the $2.95 Non-GAAP EPS beat and >$1B YoY FCF guidance raise.
